mediaWork.title: Conviction
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Anthology investigative podcast covering wrongful arrests, police misconduct (Season 1: Pedro Hernandez), and 1980s Satanic Panic wrongful convictions (Season 2: American Panic).
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Investigative anthology series from Gimlet Media / Spotify. Season 1 (hosted by Saki Knafo) follows Bronx teenager Pedro Hernandez's fight against a flawed shooting prosecution; Season 2 ("American Panic") investigates how 1980s Satanic Panic hysteria led to wrongful convictions.
